title: FMB Evidence Contracts
description: Validates evidence-image, evidence-index, and evidence-lineage runtime documents.

evidence_image.title: FMB Evidence Image Record
evidence_image.description: Records the source-evidence identity, hash observation, and held-back truth pointer policy for one FMB run.

coverage_scope.description: Retention or configuration window the adapter established for its coverage families.

evidence_index.title: FMB Evidence Index Record
evidence_index.description: Defines the evidence index envelope, including question context, collector runs, rule-engine runs, parser runs, detector runs, and tool alignment.

evidence_lineage.title: FMB Evidence Lineage
evidence_lineage.description: Defines run evidence lineage, including source evidence, transforms, worker evidence access, collector execution, analysis outputs, checks, and claim boundaries.
